description: Save the artist's own show, release party or listening party, or change one (pass event_id). It is saved as a DRAFT that only the artist sees, with whatever is known (only kind is needed), unless you pass post: true. Posting puts it on Scene for artists on Audora (and on the public page when is_public) and needs a title, starts_at and a place: a city and a country, and/or an online link. Post only when the artist asked for it to go out. An event already posted stays posted, so its changes need the same. Inviting artists or Audora stays the artist's to do in Audora; an edit keeps what they chose. Artist connections only.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

country.description: The country's name as Audora's country list writes it (get_requirements has the list), e.g. Sweden.

ends_at.description: ISO date and time, or null.

is_public.description: Show it on the artist's public page once posted. Defaults: on for a show, off for a party.

line.description: One line about it, in the artist's words.

release_id.description: A party for one of the artist's releases (once it is out).

ticket_url.description: https link to tickets or info.

time_zone.description: IANA zone where it happens, e.g. Europe/Stockholm. Needed with starts_at.

event_id.description: To change one; leave out to save a new one.

idempotency_key.description: Send the same key if you retry, and the change happens once.

post.description: true puts it on Scene now (needs title, starts_at and a place). Leave out to save a draft.

name: save_event
title: Save or post a show or party
